يبتعث (form VIII)
# يَبْتَعِثُ (yabtaʕiṯu) /jab.ta.ʕi.θu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يُبْتَعَثُ (yubtaʕaṯu) /jub.ta.ʕa.θu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يَبْتَعِثَ (yabtaʕiṯa) /jab.ta.ʕi.θa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يُب
